title: 【Taipei Night Markets Walk 4K】Raohe, Ningxia & Shilin Night Markets | Taiwan Street Food Tour
speaker: Slow Walk Abroad
zh: 【Slow Walk Abroad】【臺北夜市漫步4K】寧夏饒河、士林夜市 |臺灣街頭美食之旅（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Welcome to Raohe Street Night Market — one of Taipei’s oldest and most iconic markets.
cues.en: Welcome to Raohe Street Night Market — one of Taipei’s oldest and most iconic markets.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到饒河街夜市—臺北最古老、最具代表性的夜市之一。

cues.text: The air is filled with the smell of pepper pork buns baked in clay ovens near the gate.
cues.en: The air is filled with the smell of pepper pork buns baked in clay ovens near the gate.
cues.zh: 空氣中瀰漫著大門附近土窯烤製的胡椒豬肉包子的香味。

cues.text: Vendors line both sides of the street, offering snacks, souvenirs, and street games.
cues.en: Vendors line both sides of the street, offering snacks, souvenirs, and street games.
cues.zh: 攤販們排列在街道兩旁，販售小吃、紀念品和街頭遊戲。

cues.text: It’s a perfect mix of traditional flavors, neon lights, and the rhythm of local life.
cues.en: It’s a perfect mix of traditional flavors, neon lights, and the rhythm of local life.
cues.zh: 這裡完美地融合了傳統風味、霓虹燈和當地生活節奏。

cues.text: Raohe truly captures the heart of Taipei’s night market culture.
cues.en: Raohe truly captures the heart of Taipei’s night market culture.
cues.zh: 饒河夜市真正體現了臺北夜市文化的精髓。

cues.text: Now we arrive at Ningxia Night Market — smaller, cozier, and full of delicious food.
cues.en: Now we arrive at Ningxia Night Market — smaller, cozier, and full of delicious food.
cues.zh: 現在我們來到寧夏夜市——規模更小、氛圍更舒適，而且充滿了各種美味佳餚。

cues.text: Here, every stall tells a story, from oyster omelets to sweet taro balls.
cues.en: Here, every stall tells a story, from oyster omelets to sweet taro balls.
cues.zh: 從蚵仔煎到芋圓，每個攤位都訴說著一個故事。

cues.text: Locals gather here for late-night snacks and friendly conversation.
cues.en: Locals gather here for late-night snacks and friendly conversation.
cues.zh: 當地人聚集在這裡享用宵夜，友善地交談。

cues.text: The market may be short in length, but it’s rich in flavor and warmth.
cues.en: The market may be short in length, but it’s rich in flavor and warmth.
cues.zh: 夜市雖然不長，但卻充滿了濃鬱的風味和溫暖。

cues.text: Ningxia is where you feel the real heartbeat of Taipei.
cues.en: Ningxia is where you feel the real heartbeat of Taipei.
cues.zh: 在寧夏夜市，您可以感受到臺北真正的脈動。

cues.text: Our final stop — Shilin Night Market, the largest and most famous in Taipei.
cues.en: Our final stop — Shilin Night Market, the largest and most famous in Taipei.
cues.zh: 我們的最後一站－士林夜市，臺北規模最大、最著名的夜市。這裡是

cues.text: A lively maze of food stalls, arcades, and shops stretching through the night.
cues.en: A lively maze of food stalls, arcades, and shops stretching through the night.
cues.zh: 一個充滿活力的迷宮，遍佈小吃攤、拱廊和商店，夜夜笙歌。

cues.text: From giant fried chicken steaks to bubble tea and grilled squid, it has it all.
cues.en: From giant fried chicken steaks to bubble tea and grilled squid, it has it all.
cues.zh: 從巨型炸雞排到珍珠奶茶和烤魷魚，這裡應有盡有。

cues.text: The crowds, laughter, and aroma of street food fill every corner.
cues.en: The crowds, laughter, and aroma of street food fill every corner.
cues.zh: 熙熙攘攘的人群、歡聲笑語和街頭小吃的香氣瀰漫在每個角落。

cues.text: This is where Taipei’s nightlife comes alive — colorful, noisy, and unforgettable.
cues.en: This is where Taipei’s nightlife comes alive — colorful, noisy, and unforgettable.
cues.zh: 臺北的夜生活在這裡精彩——豐富多彩、喧鬧喧囂、令人難忘。
